summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF (EMEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through exposure toemergingmarketequities across all market capitalizations. Companyselectionuses a proprietary quantitative system. EMEM was launched on May 19, 2026 and is issued by Sophus.
